mapper.sql: id, owner_id, workspace_id, name, host, port, username, password_ciphertext, host_key_algorithm, host_key_fingerprint, host_key_public_key, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM managed_server WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO managed_server ( owner_id, workspace_id, name, host, port, username, password_ciphertext, host_key_algorithm, host_key_fingerprint, host_key_public_key, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{ownerId}, #{workspaceId}, #{name}, #{host}, #{port}, #{username}, #{passwordCiphertext}, #{hostKeyAlgorithm}, #{hostKeyFingerprint}, #{hostKeyPublicKey}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE managed_server SET workspace_id = #{workspaceId}, name = #{name}, host = #{host}, port = #{port}, username = #{username}, password_ciphertext = #{passwordCiphertext}, host_key_algorithm = #{hostKeyAlgorithm}, host_key_fingerprint = #{hostKeyFingerprint}, host_key_public_key = #{hostKeyPublicKey}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_id = #{ownerId}
